mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.work_order_id, t.flow_id, t.node_id, t.node_order, t.approver_id, t.status, t.round, t.add_sign, t.comment, t.create_time, t.update_time, u.name AS approver_name, n.node_name FROM work_order_task t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.approver_id = u.id LEFT JOIN approval_flow_node n ON t.node_id = n.id WHERE t.work_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY t.round ASC, t.node_order ASC, t.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE work_order_task SET status = #{status}, comment = #{comment}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE work_order_task SET approver_id = #{toUserId}, comment = #{comment}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
